title: fix(platform-objects): title a business unit membership by the person's and the unit's names
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X82u6K5ttmZbHo3BGfKiUPk)_
Fixes #26195

Clause-②: no (no exported type, schema field or spec key changes; `sys_business_unit_member.display_title` stays a text formula and `titleFormat` is unchanged)
Metadata-protocol: none

Part of #26059 (ruling `6416233738`, Q3 child 9). #26059 remains open; only its child card is resolved here.

## What changes

`sys_business_unit_member.display_title`, the record title Setup → Business Unit Members shows in its Title column and on the record heading, composed the two stored ids (`record.user_id + ' in ' + record.business_unit_id`). It now reads the user's name (their email where the name is blank) and the unit's name, ONE hop through each lookup:

`(isBlank(trim(record.user_id.name)) ? record.user_id.email : record.user_id.name) + ' in ' + record.business_unit_id.name`

## Mechanism (named on the card first: comment 6424698289)

A formula over related display names, using the one-hop formula read that is already on `main` (#24197, ADR-0079 addendum 2026-10-18). Nothing in `@objectstack/formula` or `packages/spec/**` is touched. It reuses the shape `sys_user_permission_set.display_title` already ships (`plugin-security/src/objects/sys-user-permission-set.object.ts:77`). The object comment that said a formula "cannot reach a related record's own title" predated #24197 and is rewritten.

- **Write cost:** none. No stored column, no hook.
- **Read cost:** one batched `sys_user` read and one batched `sys_business_unit` read per page, never one per row, under the reader's own permissions; a `findOne` makes two point reads. Reads that do not project `display_title` pay nothing.
- **Rename reach:** total and immediate. Nothing is stamped, so a renamed user or unit, or a membership moved to another user or unit, shows the new names on the next read.
- **Unchanged limits:** the title is still not sortable or searchable (ADR-0079 addendum item 9; it already was not). A user or unit the reader may not read, or one that no longer exists, leaves the title null and the console falls to `titleFormat`.
- **`titleFormat` agreement:** `titleFormat` stays `{user_id} in {business_unit_id}`. The console draws a lookup placeholder by the related record's `name`, else its `email` (`ui/packages/core/src/utils/record-title.ts` `displayNameOfEmbeddedObject`), so over an expanded row it renders the formula's text. `identity-display-title.test.ts` now asserts this over the row the hop serves.

## Evidence

**Red first, through the public door** (live `pnpm dev -- --fresh` showcase, signed in as the seeded admin, `POST` a membership then the list and record reads the console makes):

- `main` (`platform-objects` rebuilt from base `c4968860`): `GET /api/v1/data/sys_business_unit_member` and `GET .../94XQV8HLtyUCrIKZ` both serve `display_title: "7eLi5ISndhNgrM0zdFvHtlv24DnJBmQK in bu_acme"`.
- this branch (`81074800`): both serve `display_title: "Dev Admin in Acme Corporation"`. The base tree was then restored by `git checkout HEAD --` (HEAD blob hash matched, `git diff HEAD` empty) and rebuilt.

**Tests** (at `81074800`):

- New `plugin-security/src/business-unit-member-title.test.ts`, real `ObjectQL` + `SqlDriver` + the real `sys_user`, `sys_business_unit` and membership definitions: on base 7 of 8 red (`Expected "Alice Liddell in EMEA Sales"`, `Received "simLa1JzYHiOZOF5 in VJG4H1tG-WmtXsHS"`); on the branch 8/8 green. It pins the write response, `findOne`, the projected list `find`, rename and move, the email fallback, both hops read as the reader (no leak of an unreadable user or unit), a missing user or unit leaving the title null, and no stored column.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects test`: 96 files, 1361 tests passed.
- The suites that register `sys_business_unit_member` (each exit 0 on its own): `plugin-security` 228 files, 4934 passed, 45 skipped; `plugin-sharing` 55 files, 1233 passed; `plugin-approvals` 98 files, 1276 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects typecheck` and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security typecheck`: exit 0.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the three touched source files: exit 0.

**Gates:** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 67 families on this diff; all 67 ran with exit 0 (`check:i18n` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` after a full build, `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` after fetching its positive-control commit). `--ran` reconciliation: 67 derived, 67 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED.

## Acceptance notes

- File surface: the claim named the object, `identity-display-title.test.ts` "and the identity tests". The engine-level test lives in `plugin-security` because `platform-objects` has no `objectql` or `driver-sql` dependency; it sits beside the sibling's `sys-user-permission-set-person-title.test.ts`.
- Two lookups hopped at once in one formula had no prior pin (the sibling hops one); the new test covers it.
